evidence_class: prospective selected-case evaluation after separate pilots
selection_rule: Keep all six previously listed candidates. Controlled targets use their current default-branch source pins, all commits preceding cutoff, selected without test outcomes or durations. Source and workflow/dependency declarations have been read. Standardized full tests/ directory, not all upstream CI jobs, docs or optional extras.
trace_rule: From the most recent 60 completed runs created at/before cutoff, retain at most 20 most recent runs of the identified test workflow, all conclusions; order by created_at,id ascending. No test workflow means zero observed requests, not zero project test use. No additional pages or favorable replacements. Source content must be materialized; SHA-only repeat estimates are not hits. These are latest workflow-run record snapshots, ordered by original record creation, not separate execution attempts. Intermediate retry attempts and their exact chronology are unknown; run_attempt is retained. No actual rerun-demand prevalence is inferred.
main_measurement: 12 complete paired blocks per supported target, each of 6 arm permutations once in each of 2 sequential hosted jobs. Same-source producer + 4 constructed consumers. N=1 primary; N=0,2,4 secondary. Pilot targets excluded.
qualification: Explicit conditional outcome-determinism hypothesis; machine-scoped decisions are not human certification. Full-tree/staged outcome equivalence is checked at every selected source before admitting mechanical reuse. Unknown human qualification effort is retained as a cost variable; no population estimate of expert labor.
exclusions: No source/assertion edits or test-name exclusions. Missing dependencies can be added and locked before main; known unsupported effects and dependency/locale failures remain in selected-case ledger. Repairs after performance begins require a versioned protocol and retain all attempts.
qualification_cost_policy: Primary controlled-chain cost includes one additional actually executed full-tree oracle per reuse-arm qualification, source materialization and arm authority setup, then one producer and N consumers. The producer is counted once. Human review is unknown q. A separate prequalified-source sensitivity omits the extra oracle; no amortization over measurement replicates.
